name: Laurasian Cave Bear
journal_prompt: A massive, thick-furred bear of the high caves north of the strait, climbing a cliff for a wild bees' nest with more patience than you would think a thing that size could have.

taxonomy.note: Was `Ursus spelaeus narmadensis`, for a valley it does not live in. It is a bear of Mainland Asia, and none cross to Jambhudweep.
